en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4031 - Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked Abu Abdullah (as)

about a man who lends dirhams of lower quality and then receives better-quality dirhams in return, with the borrower's consent.
He (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
And this was also narrated from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as).
